newsitem.title: PANAMA: Panama president to attend Andean, Mercosur summit.
newsitem.headline: Panama president to attend Andean, Mercosur summit.

text.p: Panamanian President Ernesto Perez Balladares will attend two regional trade summits this year but Panama does not intend to try and join either bloc for the time being, Foreign Minister Ricardo Arias said on Tuesday.
He told a news conference the Panamanian leader would go to the Andean Group meeting April 22-23 in Sucre, Bolivia, and will attend the Mercosur summit June 23-24 in Asuncion, Paraguay.
Arias said Panama had no intention to try and join either trade bloc but intended to discuss trade issues.

Andean Group members are now Bolivia, Colombia, Ecuador and Venezuela following Peru's withdrawal last week over differences on tariff policy. Mercosur is comprised of Argentina, Brazil, Paraguay and Uruguay.
